rawResults.Title: Microsoft Learn MCP Server overview
rawResults.Snippet: May 22, 2026The Microsoft Learn Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server enables clients like GitHub Copilot and other AI agents to bring trusted and up-to-date information directly from Microsoft's official documentation. It's a remote MCP server that uses streamable http. It allows agents to search through documentation, fetch a complete article, and search through code samples.

rawResults.Title: Docs MCP server | LiveKit Documentation
rawResults.Snippet: Overview The LiveKit Docs MCP server gives coding agents direct access to LiveKit documentation, code search, changelogs, and examples through the Model Context Protocol . Install it in your IDE or coding agent to get accurate, up-to-date LiveKit answers without leaving your editor.
